title: Racism and hazing: After the suicide of 21-year-old Joris, a rural French town searches for answers
subhead: The family of 21-year-old Joris Laurencin is convinced that his suicide in mid-July was linked to the racist insults and repeated bullying he endured at the hands of one young man and his gang. The courts have opened an investigation against persons unknown for 'hazing, verbal abuse, repeated death threats based on race, psychological harassment and incitement to suicide.'

Yemen's deadliest fighting in years raises fears of return to all-out war
subhead: Nearly 180 fighters were killed in three days in the southwest of the country, where Houthi forces launched an offensive toward the strategic Bab al-Mandab Strait. Four years after the 2022 truce, this outbreak of violence revives the specter of the conflict that has ravaged Yemen since 2014.

title: Nepal demands greater climate justice amid staggering flood costs
subhead: The tsunami of mud, debris and ice that devastated the country on August 26 has hit several pillars of its growth, including tourism and hydropower. Damage is estimated at between $4 billion to $5 billion.

title: Where to find Paris's best veggie burgers
subhead: Forget beef – there's nothing like a tasty broccoli patty, crispy breaded eggplant rounds or a melt-in-your-mouth plantain fritter to expand the horizons of burger lovers.

title: French left renews push to raise inheritance taxes, from forced philanthropy to wealth transfer cap
subhead: From the CFDT trade union to presidential candidates Raphaël Glucksmann and Marine Tondelier, the idea of increasing inheritance taxes is back on the table. The far-right Rassemblement National opposes it. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu is considering another option: compulsory philanthropy for large inheritances.

subhead: As part of a movement led by the African Union, Paris announced on Friday that it will abandon the Mercator projection to better reflect the physical reality of the planet. France will now appear smaller on world maps.

title: In Los Angeles, George Lucas unveils $1 billion spaceship museum
subhead: The Lucas Museum of Narrative Art, whose history has been full of twists and turns, showcases the eclectic collections of the creator of Star Wars. Housed in a spectacular building, it will open to the public on September 22.

title: Sweden, a 'paradise' for the ultra-rich, debates billionaire tax ahead of elections
subhead: Regarded as one of the most egalitarian countries in the world, the number of billionaires in Sweden has continued to rise while poverty has increased. Ahead of the September 13 elections, taxing the wealthiest has become a major campaign issue.
